desc:
The NAA Bug II revolver includes the time tested characteristics that are incorporated in all NAA mini revolvers. This Combo comes with two cylinders, one chambered for the ever popular .22 Mag round, and the other chambered for the mainstay .22 LR round. The NAA Mini Revolvers can now boast greatly enhanced stability and accuracy for the shooter.
This Bug II is part of the popular Bug Out series brought to you by Talo and North American Arms. It includes textured rubber grips a safety notched cylinder, XS front sight and a metal lock box for storage or transport. It's the perfect emergency back-up pistol for every situation.
